headline: Pick of the Day (short-term delivery call)

highlights: Investment rationale: EV- led growth engine: DTL is a key beneficiary of India's EV transition, with ~70% market share in electric 2W/3W wiring harnesses.
EV revenues surged 108% YoY to Rs 570 cr in 2QFY27, raising EV contribution to 31% of total sales.

Growth was supported by strong EV demand, commencement of supplies for a leading South India-based OEM's powertrain battery program, and entry into Hero MotoCorp's EV ecosystem through the Multilink acquisition, further strengthening growth visibility.
Reflecting sustained demand momentum, management has raised FY27 revenue growth guidance from ~30% to 40-45%+.
